newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National down further in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National down further in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc dropped in early trading on Friday, extending yesterday's losses as one market-maker was caught long of stock, dealers said.
The stock was down 10-1/2p or 1.3 percent at 773 by 0845 GMT in volume of 523,476 shares. "There was a long position in the market," said one market-maker in Abbey shares.
Shares in the banking group closed 18-1/2p lower on Thursday despite hitting a near-record peak of 806p early in the session.
The stock was dragged lower by fears of increased competition in the mortgage market and as Scottish Amicable -- which Abbey has declared an interest in buying -- opened itself to bids.
But dealers played down fears that Abbey could get dragged into a bidding war for the mutually-owned group.
"They were never going to steal it," said one.
